title: Perfect derived complexes descend through directed inverse limits of qcqs schemes
author: The Stacks Project Authors
difficulty_reason: Finite presentation handles individual affine complexes but does not supply global descent of their derived gluing data. The proof descends complexes on two open pieces, descends their overlap isomorphism, and uses a map to derived pushforward to glue an object whose derived pullback is the original perfect complex.
